concepts.title: Convex subgroup of an ordered abelian group
concepts.description: A subgroup H such that h₁≤g≤h₂ with h₁,h₂∈H forces g∈H. The quotient carries the induced order when H is convex.

concepts.title: Convex subset of a real vector space
concepts.description: A subset C of a real vector space is convex if (1−t)x+ty∈C whenever x,y∈C and0≤t≤1. The vector space may be infinite-dimensional.

concepts.title: Coprime integers
concepts.description: Integers whose greatest common divisor is1.

concepts.title: Cuspidal automorphic representation
concepts.description: An irreducible unitary representation occurring as a closed summand in the cuspidal L²-space of the adelic group, with the chosen central or Harish–Chandra normalization. Its smooth K∞-finite vectors give the usual algebraic automorphic representation.

concepts.title: Dense subset of a metric space
concepts.description: A subset A of a metric space X is dense if every open ball centered in X with positive radius meets A.

concepts.title: Attraction height for a digit-power sum map
concepts.description: For fixed b,e and target u, the attraction height of x is the least h≥0 with S_{e,b}^h(x)=u, when such an h exists.

concepts.title: Digit-power sum map
concepts.description: For base b≥2 and integer e≥1, S_{e,b}(x) is the sum of the e-th powers of the base-b digits of the positive integer x.

concepts.title: Dimension group
concepts.description: A directed unperforated partially ordered abelian group with the Riesz decomposition property.

concepts.title: Handelman–Roy unperforation criterion for finite-trace dimension groups
concepts.description: Let G be a simple noncyclic dimension group with finitely many pure traces,and H=ker_G Z(H) a subgroup with H∩G⁺={0},where Z(H) consists of normalized traces vanishing on H. If F is the smallest face containing Z(H),then G/H is unperforated iff f(H) is zero or dense inℝ for every f∈F.

concepts.title: Diophantine equation
concepts.description: A polynomial equation, usually with integer coefficients, whose solutions are required to be integers or rational numbers.

concepts.title: Dirichlet character
concepts.description: A group character of (Z/qZ)× with complex values, extended periodically to Z by zero on integers not coprime to q. A character is primitive when it is not induced from a proper divisor of q.

concepts.title: Dirichlet L-function
concepts.description: For a Dirichlet character χ, the Dirichlet series L(s,χ)=∑_{n≥1}χ(n)n^(−s) for Re(s)>1, together with its meromorphic continuation.

concepts.title: Distinguished automorphic representation
concepts.description: A representation with a nonzero equivariant period functional for a specified subgroup and character; the subgroup and character are part of the specification.

concepts.title: Elliott–Halberstam conjecture
concepts.description: The primes have every level of distribution θ<1, in the averaged arithmetic-progression error sense, with arbitrary logarithmic saving.

concepts.title: Holomorphic Eisenstein series for SL₂(Z)
concepts.description: For even k≥4, the modular form E_k(τ)=½∑_(c,d)=1(cτ+d)^(−k), normalized to constant Fourier coefficient 1. The weight-two series E₂=1−24∑_{n≥1}σ₁(n)q^n is quasimodular rather than modular.

concepts.title: Sturm’s congruence bound for elliptic modular forms
concepts.description: For a weight-k holomorphic modular form on SL₂(ℤ) with p-integral rational Fourier coefficients a(n), vanishing a(n) modulo p for 0≤n≤⌊k/12⌋ forces all coefficients to vanish modulo p.

concepts.title: Euler brick
concepts.description: A rectangular box whose edges and all three face diagonals have integer lengths; its space diagonal need not have integer length.
